title: The Hare and the Hedgehog

full_text:
On a crisp autumn morning, a hedgehog walked through the turnip field, humming a cheerful tune. He met the long-legged Hare, who greeted him with sneering arrogance: "Look at your crooked, stubby little legs! How can anyone crawl through life with such ridiculous pins?"

"My legs may be short," bristled the hedgehog, "but they can run faster than your long stilts! I will wager a golden thaler and a bottle of fine wine that I can beat you in a race across this plowed field!"

The Hare laughed uproariously and accepted the challenge. The hedgehog hurried home and told his wife: "Dress yourself in a waistcoat like mine and come to the lower end of the furrow. When the Hare arrives, simply stand up and shout: 'I am here already!'"

The race began. The Hare bounded forward like the wind, kicking up dust and leaping over furrows. When he reached the far end, out popped the hedgehog's wife, dusting her prickles and calling: "I am here already!"

Baffled and furious, the Hare turned around and sprinted back: "Run again!" When he touched the top furrow, the hedgehog himself stepped out, smiling: "I am here already!"

Seventy-three times the proud Hare galloped back and forth along the furrows, growing more exhausted and bewildered with every dash, while at every finish line a prickly head popped up with the cheerful cry: "I am here already!"

On the seventy-fourth sprint, the Hare collapsed in the mud, completely spent. The hedgehog took his golden thaler and his bottle of wine, and strolled happily home with his clever wife, teaching everyone that a clever mind and a loyal partner can outrun the fastest boaster in the world.
moral: Arrogant mockery of another’s stature is swiftly humbled by teamwork and clever wits.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "The Hare and the Hedgehog"?
options: Presence of mind and quiet wisdom triumph over brute strength.
Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.
